caption:
Two blessings many people lose without noticing

The Prophet ﷺ said there are two blessings that many people are deceived into losing: health and free time. Tonight, give one free hour to something you will be glad you did.

Sahih al-Bukhari 6412 · Grade: Sahih

Which hour of tomorrow will you protect?
